text: 1. Plan. Preview many packages checked many need building: default, selects direct CRAN reverse dependencies. Planning download, build, check packages. Use plan$requirements inspect package system requirements. 2. Prepare. Reuse cached binaries build remaining packages: prepared$problems rows, resolve checking (see retrying ). Preparation can take several minutes without printing progress, even reusing cached work. 3. Check. Compare released development versions: result prints summary; result$results lists package’s outcome: unchanged, changed, incomplete, not_checked. Review changed results use result$diagnostics investigate incomplete checks treating run complete.
code: library(revdeprunner)  package <- "/path/to/development/package" plan <- revdep_plan(package)  plan prepared <- revdep_prepare(plan)  prepared prepared$problems if (nrow(prepared$problems) == 0L) {   result <- revdep_check(prepared)    result   result$results   result$diagnostics }
